quandoUsar: The background of a highlight section, such as a landing page hero or a login screen, with slow motion in the accent color.
Backgrounds that should follow light and dark themes and the accent color with no configuration: the colors come from tokens and are reread when the theme changes.
quandoEvitar: Behind long text, tables, or forms, a moving background hurts reading; use a smooth surface.
Use `hero-section` when you need the whole hero ready-made, with title, buttons, and illustrations, and not just the background.
It does not suit as the background of every card in a list or grid: each instance is its own WebGL canvas.
acessibilidade: The canvas is `aria-hidden` and receives no pointer; the content comes in `children`, in a layer above, with whatever semantics you give it.
The field blends the page background with patches in the accent color; check the text contrast on top and reduce `intensity` if needed.
movimento: A noise field folded over itself flows slowly, like liquid; `speed` changes the pace (0 freezes), `scale` the detail size, and `intensity` the strength of the highlight.
The canvas appears with a 0.48 s fade when the first frame is ready; before that, and without WebGL, the smooth `--background` surface remains.
With “reduce motion”, the field stays still on a fixed frame and the initial fade is turned off; `paused` freezes the current frame and resumes from the same point.
responsivo: It takes the size of its own element, with a height of at least 12 rem, and redraws when it is resized.
desempenho: The `requestAnimationFrame` loop only runs while the background is on screen, the tab is visible, `paused` is off, and `speed` is not 0; when stopped, it draws once and spends nothing more.
`quality` (default 0.75) reduces the pixels drawn, with density capped at 2×; each instance is its own WebGL context, so use few per page.
notasIA: Import `ShaderBackground` from `@/components/ryan-ui/shader-background/shader-background` and put the content as the child; set the height with `className` or let the content set it (minimum 12 rem).
The colors come from `--background`, `--surface-muted`, and `--accent`; for another tone, change those tokens on an ancestor instead of editing the shader.
Offer a pause button tied to `paused` when the background stays on screen for a long time, as in the demo.
